author: Xinlu Liang
description:
A slow-paced Chinese reality show about fractured friendships has proved an unexpected cultural phenomenon, sparking a nationwide reckoning over huorengan – the messy, unscripted sense of being alive – as AI companions and algorithm-driven microdramas flourish.
The show’s emotional power is distilled in a viral scene when two women who barely spoke to each other for seven years sit across a small wooden table.
One of them, singer Xu Fei, unfolds a handwritten letter and begins to read it aloud....
title: Why a slow-paced show about broken friendships is China’s antidote to AI fatigue

author: Caroline Lin
description:
The just-concluded Apec summit in Shenzhen showcased China’s role as a regional leader, state news agency Xinhua said on Saturday, casting the city’s rapid rise as a model for an “Asia-Pacific miracle” under Chinese guidance.
In an article detailing Chinese President Xi Jinping’s activities at the November 18-19 event, Xinhua noted how China’s three stints as annual summit host charted the nation’s progression from “integrating into” and “developing” the Asia-Pacific to actively “leading” the...
title: How China showcased the ‘Shenzhen miracle’ in Apec cooperation push

author: Ling Xin
description:
China should test making water or oxygen on the moon no later than 2030, according to the chief designer of its lunar programme, as the country’s race with the US to settle there heats up.
In a paper to be published in the Journal of Deep Space Exploration, physicist Wu Weiren and his team said China needed to prove at least one key technology, such as extracting ice or pulling oxygen from the dusty ground, during its next robotic Chang’e mission or planned crewed landing.
Their road map then...
title: China unveils space mining road map with a big move on the moon within 4 years

author: Jevans Nyabiage
description:
For a group of Guinean railway workers, the track to driving trains runs through China, where they are learning to operate locomotives for the massive Simandou iron ore project.
Under the Simandou Academy programme, 62 Guinean workers are attending a four-month course in Baotou, Inner Mongolia, combining classroom lessons, simulations and practical work with locomotives. Those who pass the final assessment will return to help operate the railway that serves Simandou.
Last month, Guinea’s...
title: How railway training helps China’s ties with African partners stay on track

author: Caroline Lin
description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump agreed during talks at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit that “humans should always be involved” in military decisions involving artificial intelligence (AI), according to US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.
Speaking to US broadcaster CNBC on Friday, Bessent said the consensus was a breakthrough of the leaders’ meeting on Thursday, adding that both sides agreed “humans should always be involved in any military...
title: Xi, Trump agree military AI decisions must involve humans, Bessent says

author: Albee Zhang
description:
New vehicles for drone and anti-drone warfare have been spotted at the site where the Zhuhai air show will be held next month, reflecting China’s push to integrate hi-tech platforms on land battlefields as well as its ambitions in the global defence market.
Images and videos circulating online show hardware including two unmanned combat vehicles – one equipped with Hongjian missiles – and a new type of anti-drone tactical vehicle at the site in southeastern China where the air show will be held...
title: Tanks, drone and anti-drone vehicles spotted at Zhuhai air show site

author: William Zheng
description:
China’s top intelligence agency has warned that no nation can achieve “absolute security” at the expense of others, underscoring Beijing’s messaging on security just a day after Thursday’s unprecedented China-US-Russia trilateral summit.
In a commentary published on its official social account on Friday, the Ministry of State Security (MSS) framed China’s security philosophy as both a theoretical evolution of Marxism and “an urgent response to mounting geopolitical instability”.
The article,...
title: China’s top intelligence agency touts ‘common international security’ after summit

author: Stephanie Sam
description:
“Please stop being such a Chinese honeypot.”
When reports emerged alleging that then-Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang had been romantically involved with a Chinese woman suspected of espionage, my inbox filled with remarks from friends and acquaintances about my supposed career as a Chinese spy. One came from an old university mate I hadn’t seen in more than a decade.
Underneath the humour was a more revealing assumption. I am a British woman of Vietnamese-Chinese ancestry, with no family...
title: Who are you calling a ‘Chinese honeypot’?
